text: Ahmed starts at the council on 3rd of November. He's nervous about the commute more than the job itself.

Lunch with Marta. Her sister Ciara has an interview with Deloitte on 12 November and has been practising case studies every night. Marta thinks she's overpreparing, but Ciara was turned down by two firms last spring and doesn't want to go through that again. Their dad keeps sending her articles about consulting, which isn't helping.
Stefan is retiring at the end of March after thirty-one years at the depot. His wife Ann is already planning a cruise for April 14.
Remind me to text Mei good luck the night before her panel interview on 6/11.
Jack got the promotion! Team lead from 1 December. He wants to celebrate properly once the restructure settles.
Heather's last day at the library is Friday. She's been there since before the kids were born and sounded quite emotional about it.
Bilal applied for the paramedic course again. Results are out on January 9th. Last year he missed out by two points.

Called Georgia. Her dad is having his hip done on 21/11, so she's taking the week off work. Her brother Hamza is flying back from Dubai on the 19th to help. She's worried about how her mum will cope with the stairs once he's home, and her own manager hasn't been very understanding about the leave.
Need to post my application for the Leeds role before 31 October.
Katarzyna mentioned she collects vintage Polish film posters. Good to know for Christmas.
Florin and Rana are both leaving the firm at the same time, which is a bit odd. Their joint leaving drinks are on November 28th at the Crown.
Mohammed's son Archie has his first day as an apprentice electrician on Monday 2 November. Mohammed is more anxious than Archie is.
Don't forget to ask Yuki how the second interview went. It was on Tuesday.
Beatriz has been offered head of science, but she only starts after Easter. Until then she's covering two roles and is exhausted.
Abigail is vegan now, apparently since the summer. Book somewhere suitable for the team lunch.
Mariam and her husband are expecting their first in May. She told me after the meeting.

Vera rang. The redundancy consultation is on 10/11 and she has no idea whether her role is safe. I should check in with her that evening. She's the main earner since her husband went part time, and their eldest is starting university in September, so the timing could hardly be worse.
Kieran is going for the sous chef job at the new place on the high street. Trial shift is 15 November. He's terrified of the head chef, who used to be on telly.
Vikram Shah, or Vik as everyone at work calls him, is moving to the Singapore office in January. His partner Lars is going with him.
Haircut at 9 tomorrow, then pick up the dry cleaning.

Emre told me his mum is retiring from nursing next month. Forty years on the wards. He wants to throw her a surprise party but his sister thinks she'd hate it. Compromise idea: a quiet dinner at their aunt's on 14/11 with just family. He asked if I'd help with the slideshow, so I need to dig out the old photos he sent me.
Hemi's interview at the museum got cancelled because they've frozen hiring. He's gutted. Must message him at the weekend.
Manon starts her PhD in Lyon on September 21st. She's taking her cat Biscuit with her, which involves a ridiculous amount of paperwork.
Mai passed her probation! Permanent from today.
Met Bogdan's new boss at the barbecue. Seemed fine. Bogdan says the first month has been brutal though, lots of late nights.
Amara's brother got into the police training programme. Intake is 4th of January. Their mum is over the moon.
I'm driving Ahmed to his assessment centre on 18 Nov, so leave early that day. Remind me to ask him afterwards how the group exercise went.
Stefan's daughter graduates in Edinburgh on 7 December. He and Ann are booking the sleeper train.
Ciara Lopez got the Deloitte job. Starts 11 January. Send her a card with something silly in it.
Jack hinted that he'd love a decent pair of noise-cancelling headphones for the new open-plan office.
Note to self: update my CV and LinkedIn this weekend. The recruiter said the role closes on November 20th.
Heather's leaving do was lovely. Her husband Archie gave a speech that had everyone in tears. She's taking a month off before deciding what's next.
Bilal's interview for the ambulance trust is 24/11. He keeps saying he's fine but he's clearly not sleeping.

Georgia mentioned her partner Kieran has just been made redundant. They're okay for money for now, but he's very low. I should invite them both round for dinner next week. Kieran has an interview with a catering company on November 19th, his first since it happened, and Georgia says he's convinced he'll mess it up.
Hamza is allergic to nuts and shellfish. Worth remembering for the reunion.
Florin has decided not to take the Bristol job after all. The move was meant to be on 1 December; that's off now. He's staying put and asking for a raise instead.
Rana's mum turns seventy on 30th November. Rana is organising a family meal and is stressed because her two brothers can't agree on a restaurant.
Katarzyna started at the hospital pharmacy last week. Loves it so far, though the night shifts start on 9 November and she's dreading those.
Must ring Mohammed on the 5th. His appeal hearing about the dismissal is that afternoon.
Yuki Tanaka and her wife are celebrating ten years married on October 30th. They're going to Kyoto in the spring to mark it properly.
Beatriz's husband has a job interview in Manchester on 13/11. If he gets it they'd move up by Easter, which she's torn about.
Lovely chat with Abigail. She's training for the half marathon in March and has just started a new role in procurement. Her boss sounds like a nightmare.
Mariam's scan is on 2nd of December. Her mum is coming over from Cairo for it.

Vera's interview for the operations manager post is on Monday. She's applied for nine jobs since the summer and this is the first that's gone anywhere. Text her good luck on Sunday evening, and ask how it went on Tuesday.
Vikram's farewell lunch is 15 Jan. I'm sorting the collection, so start the envelope round by the 8th.
Lars is an amazing baker. He brought a cardamom bun thing to the office and it vanished in minutes.

Emre got the job at the architecture practice. He found out on Wednesday and starts on November 16th. His girlfriend Mei is throwing him a little party on Saturday. Don't forget to bring wine. Emre also said his brother has applied to the same practice for a graduate role, which could be awkward if they end up working together.
Hemi's dad passed away at the weekend. Funeral is 27 October in Rotorua, and Hemi flies out on the 23rd. I need to send flowers to the family and message Hemi before he goes.

Manon told me Mai has been head-hunted by a rival agency. Mai hasn't decided yet; the offer expires on 4/12. The money is much better but it would mean a longer commute, and her husband has just started a new job himself on December 1st. Manon reckons she'll take it.

Bogdan's wife Marta is going back to work after maternity leave on 9 November. The baby starts nursery the same week. They're both a bit wobbly about it. Marta's manager has agreed to three days a week until February, and Bogdan's mum is helping with pick-ups on Thursdays. Remind me to drop round with dinner that first week.
Amara has been at the same firm for twelve years and finally got made partner. The announcement is on December 1st. I should get her something nice, maybe that fountain pen she keeps looking at.
Groceries, gym at 6, then finish the cover letter for the Bath job. Deadline 3 November.
Archie, Mohammed's son, failed his electrical theory test, but he can resit on 14 December. Mohammed is being very calm about it. Remind me to ask Archie how revision is going.
Ann's brother Jack is coming to stay from Australia for Christmas. Stefan isn't thrilled; they haven't spoken properly in years.
Ciara's interview prep paid off. Her sister Marta says she's already been asked to lead a project in week two.
Heather is thinking about retraining as a counsellor. The course application deadline is 15 January and she wants me to read her personal statement.
Spent the evening on the Acme application form. Submitted. Nothing else to do but wait.

Kieran Baker starts his new job on 23 November, the sous chef role he went for. He sounded really proud on the phone. His mum Heather keeps telling everyone. Send him a congratulations text, and maybe pop into the restaurant on the 28th to try the menu.
Bilal's sister Mariam said he had a rough week. He got the paramedic place but his landlord is selling, so he has to move by 31/12 as well. Too much at once. Call him Thursday.

Georgia told me that Florin, Rana and Vik are all going to the same conference in Lisbon on 10-12 November. Florin is presenting on the 11th and is already panicking about the slides. Rana's flying in early on the 9th to see her cousin. Vik is only coming for the dinner.
